verdict.rationale: ClickUp's API and docs show explicit support for custom fields (moving/adding custom fields to lists) and custom task types, and a Hacker News user (a long-time Jira convert) praises ClickUp specifically for making it fast to reconfigure task statuses versus Jira's rigid workflow engine. Together this shows both first-party capability and independent corroboration that fields/statuses are customizable to match team process. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation on configuring workflow statuses/stages in the UI (only inferred via API custom fields and one community comment), and no hands-on demonstration of full workflow-status editing.
